_comment: #515 continuous-journey registry, read by qa/journey_gate.py. Every entry must exist in qa/manifest.json carrying the `journey` tier, and every manifest row carrying `journey` must be listed here, so content changes cannot silently drop a route. checkpoint = the dump_checkpoint slot the route must reach; budget_sec = measured headless wall time with headroom (see docs/design/571-cutover-execution.md).
